If the full version includes the proposed formula in Section 3, check exactly how the L1 term enters the attention logit: as a negative distance penalty, a normalization correction, or a learned mixture. Also check whether it changes logit scale or softmax temperature. The related work section can be read quickly. The current evidence should not be extrapolated to pretraining benefits until model-training experiments with multiple seeds and compute-overhead measurements are available.

recommendation.zh: 注意力相似度的几何修正思路值得架构设计参考，重点看§2的混合相似度公式和§4的头级 specialization 分析
recommendation.en: The geometric correction of attention similarity is a useful reference for Transformer architecture design; focus on §2's hybrid similarity formula and §4's head specialization analysis

paper.title: Can Transformers Really Do It All? On the Compatibility of Inductive Biases Across Tasks
paper.abstract: Transformers are remarkably versatile and their design is largely consistent across a variety of applications. But are they optimal for any given task or dataset? The answer may be key for pushing AI beyond merely scaling current designs.   *Method.* We present a method to optimize a transformer architecture for a given dataset, which we use as a tool to study optimal task-specific inductive biases. This method replaces the most important non-linearities (GeLUs,;softmax) with functions learned o

summary.core_problem: Transformer 的归纳偏置（如 GeLU 和 Softmax）是否对所有任务都是最优的？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过在保留数据上学习非线性函数来优化特定数据集 Transformer 架构的方法，揭示了不同任务对归纳偏置的特定需求，挑战了 Transformer '一招鲜' 的普遍假设。
summary.technical_approach: 将 Transformer 中最重要的非线性组件（GeLU 和 Softmax）替换为在保留数据上学习的函数。通过在不同数据集上训练这些优化后的架构，评估任务对之间归纳偏置的兼容性。
summary.experiments: 在算法玩具任务上，新架构在学习速度、分布内/外泛化和种子稳定性方面有显著提升，但高度任务特异。在代码和语言任务上，也观察到了类似的任务特异性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Rutgers University 和 University of Adelaide。

summary_en.core_problem: Are the inductive biases of Transformers (e.g., GeLU, Softmax) optimal for all tasks?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method to optimize Transformer architectures for specific datasets by learning non-linear functions on held-out data, revealing task-specific needs for inductive biases and challenging the 'one-size-fits-all' assumption of Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces the most important non-linearities (GeLU and Softmax) in Transformers with functions learned on held-out data. Evaluates the compatibility of inductive biases between task pairs by training these optimized architectures on different datasets.
summary_en.experiments: On algorithmic toy tasks, new architectures show dramatic improvements in learning speed, in/out-of-distribution generalization, and seed stability, but are highly task-specific. Similar task specificity is observed on code and language tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Rutgers University and University of Adelaide.

recommendation.zh: 通过学习非线性激活函数来探究 Transformer 归纳偏置的任务特异性，对理解模型架构的泛化能力有一定启发，可关注其在算法任务上的实验设计。
recommendation.en: Explores task-specific inductive biases of Transformers by learning non-linear activation functions, offering insights into architecture generalization; the experimental design on algorithmic tasks is worth noting.

paper.title: The Geometry of Semantic Space: A Continuous Geometric Framework for the Transformer Architecture
paper.abstract: We present a continuous geometric framework that models the discrete algebraic operations of the Transformer architecture as an integro-differential equation (IDE) on a semantic fiber bundle $\calE = \calM \times \R^d$. Beginning from a single geometric axiom -- that the token sequence forms a discrete $1$-manifold equipped with a canonical measure lattice -- we translate every core component of the modern Transformer (RMSNorm, RoPE, Softmax Attention, FFN, Residual Stream, SGD, Weight Decay) in

summary.core_problem: 缺乏一个统一的连续几何框架，把 Transformer 各离散组件（RMSNorm、RoPE、注意力、FFN、残差、SGD、weight decay）放在同一数学语言下解释。
summary.importance: 尝试用纤维丛、测度论、随机微积分统一描述 Transformer，并把注意力对应到 Schrödinger bridge、SGD 对应到破坏细致平衡的 Itô 扩散，属于原理性框架工作。
summary.technical_approach: 以“token 序列构成带典范测度格的离散 1-流形”为单一几何公理，将 RMSNorm、RoPE、Softmax Attention、FFN、残差流、SGD、Weight Decay 翻译为语义纤维丛 E=M×R^d 上的积分-微分方程，横跨最优传输与非平衡热力学。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3、LLaMA-3.1、Gemma-3、GPT-2、Mistral 共 5 个架构、124M 到 8B 参数规模上做六组实验验证框架给出的量化预测，具体实验细节摘要未完全披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Zhihua Liang 隶属 INFN Cagliari，偏向物理/数学视角，非主流 Transformer 工程团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Lacks a unified continuous-geometric framework that describes all discrete Transformer components (RMSNorm, RoPE, attention, FFN, residual, SGD, weight decay) in one mathematical language.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a principle-level framework using fiber bundles, measure theory, and stochastic calculus to unify Transformer components, identifying attention with Schrödinger bridges and SGD with detailed-balance-violating Itô diffusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starts from a single geometric axiom that the token sequence forms a discrete 1-manifold with a canonical measure lattice, then translates every component into integro-differential equations on a semantic fiber bundle E=M×R^d, drawing connections to entropic optimal transport and non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
summary_en.experiments: Runs a six-part empirical campaign across Qwen3, LLaMA-3.1, Gemma-3, GPT-2, and Mistral from 124M to 8B to test the framework's quantitative predictions; full details are not in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Single author at INFN Sezione di Cagliari; the perspective is physics/math-heavy rather than coming from a mainstream Transformer engineering team.

recommendation.zh: 几何化叙事有美感但多为 post-hoc 类比，暂未产出可直接改训练或架构的预测，作为 mechanism 文献备查。
recommendation.en: Aesthetically appealing geometric unification, but reads largely as post-hoc analogy without actionable predictions yet; treat as background mechanism reading.

institutions: INFN, Sezione di Cagliari, I-09042 Monserrato (CA)

paper.title: An Adjoint-Sensitivity Framework for Lost-in-the-Middle Phenomena in Causal Residual Transformers
paper.abstract: We develop an adjoint-sensitivity framework for positional influence in causal residual Transformers and separate unconditional analytic results from conditional boundary-shape conclusions. The principal unconditional theorem is the residual-to-depth-flow estimate for layer controls converging in $L^1$, complemented by a finite-token-to-Volterra attention estimate that explicitly controls the first cells near the causal endpoint. We define a normalized adjoint-energy influence density and derive

summary.core_problem: 因果残差Transformer中位置影响（尤其是lost-in-the-middle现象）的理论机制缺乏统一量化分析框架，现有归因多为经验性结论
summary.importance: 机制分析创新，首次提出伴随灵敏度框架量化位置对输出的影响，推导严格理论结果，澄清lost-in-the-middle的成因条件
summary.technical_approach: 开发伴随灵敏度框架，定义归一化伴随能量影响密度，将其沿全批量梯度流的演化分解为残差传输、非局部Volterra和局部通道三类项，分离无条件解析结果与条件边界形状结论，严格推导残差到深度流的L1收敛估计和注意力的Volterra控制界
summary.experiments: 纯理论推导工作，无实验验证，给出因果掩码、残差路径对位置敏感性影响的严格数学结论

summary_en.core_problem: The theoretical mechanism of positional influence (especially the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon) in causal residual Transformers lacks a unified quantitative analysis framework, and existing attributions are mostly empirical
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis innovation, first proposes an adjoint-sensitivity framework to quantify positional impact on outputs, derives rigorous theoretical results, and clarifies the conditions for the formation of lost-in-the-middle
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops an adjoint-sensitivity framework, defines normalized adjoint-energy influence density, decomposes its evolution along full-batch gradient flow into residual transmission, nonlocal Volterra, and local channel terms, separates unconditional analytic results from conditional boundary-shape conclusions, rigorously derives L1 convergence estimate for residual-to-depth flow and Volterra control bound for attention
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical derivation work, no experimental validation, presents rigorous mathematical conclusions on the impact of causal masking and residual paths on positional sensitivity

recommendation.zh: 纯理论的位置敏感性分析框架，修正了lost-in-the-middle的单一因素归因，做长上下文机制研究可参考结论，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: Pure theoretical framework for positional sensitivity analysis, corrects single-factor attribution of lost-in-the-middle, reference conclusions for long-context mechanism research, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Gate-Zero Growth: A Geometric Framework for Function-Preserving Continual Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce \emph{gate-zero growth}, a function-preserving (FP) operator for continual learning that adds new residual blocks through a zero-initialised gate. Under a transversality condition, gate-zero growth induces \emph{rank separation} in the functional Jacobian: old directions are unchanged, new-weight directions are exactly flat at the growth point, and new gate directions are the only first-order source of new functional variation. As gates open during continual learning, function drift

summary.core_problem: Transformer 持续学习中如何在新增残差块扩容时严格保持旧函数不变，并在后续训练中可控地偏离以最小化遗忘。
summary.importance: 提出一种 function-preserving 扩容算子 gate-zero growth，给出函数漂移和 Jacobian 泄漏的形式化界，为 continual pretrain / 扩容式训练提供了一个干净的几何框架。
summary.technical_approach: 新增残差块通过零初始化门控接入；在横截性条件下证明 rank separation：旧方向不变、新权重方向在增长点处严格平坦、仅新门控方向提供一阶函数变化；门打开时函数漂移为 O(||α||²)、Jacobian 泄漏为 O(||α||_∞)。
summary.experiments: 在 WikiText-103 → BookCorpus 上做 300M → 857M Transformer 扩容，gate-zero growth 在 Isolation 和 Freeze-Nothing 两种设置下旧域遗忘 Δ_A < 0.1，而非 FP 对照 G_stack 遗忘大一个数量级。

summary_en.core_problem: How to grow Transformers in continual learning by adding residual blocks while exactly preserving the old function, then controllably departing to minimize forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Proposes gate-zero growth, a function-preserving growth operator with formal bounds on function drift and Jacobian leakage, offering a clean geometric framework for continual pretraining and model expansion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inserts new residual blocks via zero-initialized gates; proves rank separation under a transversality condition: old directions unchanged, new-weight directions exactly flat at the growth point, only new gate directions contribute first-order functional variation; as gates open, drift is O(||α||²) and Jacobian leakage O(||α||_∞).
summary_en.experiments: On WikiText-103 → BookCorpus, grows a 300M→857M Transformer; gate-zero growth achieves near-zero old-domain forgetting (Δ_A < 0.1) under both Isolation and Freeze-Nothing, while non-FP control G_stack shows an order-of-magnitude larger forgetting.

recommendation.zh: 持续扩容/continual pretrain 方向可备查，几何分析干净，但规模仅 300M→857M，结论能否外推到十亿级存疑。
recommendation.en: Useful reference for continual-pretrain/model-growth work; the geometric analysis is clean, but scale (300M→857M) is too small to trust extrapolation to billion-scale regimes.

paper.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
paper.abstract: Transformer reasoning is limited by autoregressive decoding, which repeat edly compresses rich hidden computation through token space and makes it difficult for intermediate reasoning states to persist across time. We in troduce Transformers with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence (T2MLR), a transformers-based latent reasoning architecture that fuses a cached middle layer representation from the previous token directly into an earlier layer of the current token position, enabling abstract intermed

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“让 Transformer 多想几步”这么泛的问题，而是一个更具体的架构瓶颈：标准自回归解码把每一步的高维中间计算都压回 token 空间，再由下一个 token 重新展开，导致跨时间持续存在的潜在推理状态很难保留。已有 latent reasoning 方法通常把递归信号放在输入嵌入或最终层附近，离真正承载抽象推理的中间层较远；另一类 depth looping 方法虽然能增加单 token 计算，但推理成本会随循环次数上升。T^2MLR 的目标是把“跨 token 持续的连续推理状态”直接安放在中间层，并且尽量不破坏标准 teacher-forcing 预训练和低开销推理。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“latent reasoning 该放在哪里”这个问题提供了一个很清楚的答案：不是输入端，也不是只在输出端，而是中间层。这个判断和 mechanistic interpretability 中关于中层承担抽象组合与关系推理的观察是对齐的。第二，它提出了一种仍然兼容 dense token-level supervision 的连续推理架构，避免了很多 latent CoT 方法在训练可扩展性上的硬伤，尤其是 sequence parallel 下的 teacher-forced pretraining。第三，它的收益不是只出现在小型合成任务上，而是延续到自然语言预训练、下游多跳推理、以及对现有 1.7B instruct 模型的 retrofit，这说明它更像一个可插入的基座改造方向，而不是只在特定 benchmark 上成立的技巧。贡献量级上，我会把它看成“值得持续跟踪的架构分支”：还谈不上替代标准 AR Transformer，但已经把 latent recurrence 从概念推进到可预训练、可扩展、可低开销部署的阶段。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是 temporal middle-layer recurrence。模型在前一个 token 的某个较深中间层缓存表示，然后在当前 token 的一个较早中间层把这份缓存通过门控融合进去。这样做有两个关键点。其一，递归信号不是从 embedding 重新进入网络，而是直接注入到中层计算图里，因此前一时刻形成的抽象状态可以在后续 token 的中层继续演化。其二，作者强调 recurrence 只放在局部中层，而不是全层都做递归。原因很直接：早层更偏词法和局部句法，晚层更接近词表投影；把递归集中在中层更符合功能分工，也更省参数和算力。

从实现上看，T^2MLR 需要定义一对层位点：一个“写入层”产生要缓存的中间状态，一个“读取层”在下一个 token 处接收该状态。两者之间通过一个 gated fusion 模块连接，门控负责控制当前 token 本地表示与前一 token 持续状态的混合比例。这个设计和简单 residual addition 的区别在于，它允许模型按上下文动态决定何时依赖跨时间潜变量，何时主要依赖当前 token 的标准前向计算。

训练上的难点比结构本身更重要。严格的时间递归会让 teacher forcing 下不同位置之间产生真实依赖，从而破坏标准并行训练。作者提出 approximate temporal-parallel training 来恢复可扩展性：训练时对递归路径做近似并行化处理，使得序列维度仍可并行，而不是像 RNN 那样完全串行。论文把这一点作为可预训练性的关键，因为如果没有这一步，架构即使概念上成立，也很难在大规模语料上训练。这里值得注意的是，它不是完全精确地复现推理时的递归，而是在训练可扩展性和递归保真度之间做了工程折中。

和相关方法相比，差异很明确。相对 latent-recurrent methods，它把状态放在中层而不是输入端；相对 depth-looping methods，它把额外计算沿时间维传播，而不是在单 token 内反复过层，因此推理时每 token 只多一个轻量递归融合，而不是多次整网循环；相对标准 Transformer，它显式提供了跨 token 的连续隐状态通路，缓解 token bottleneck。
summary.experiments:
实验分成四块，结构比较完整。

第一块是合成任务 S5-Retrieval。这个任务同时要求不可解群状态跟踪和 in-context retrieval，单纯 Transformer 或单纯 recurrent 模型都难以胜任。作者用它证明中层时间递归确实能表达“跨步持续的抽象状态”，不是只在自然语言任务上靠数据偏置取巧。摘要里没有给出具体数值，但正文结论是 shallow T^2MLR 能解这类标准架构失败的组合任务，这对机制层面的说服力很重要。

第二块是自然语言预训练。作者在 data- and parameter-matched 设置下比较 T^2MLR 与标准 Transformer，结果是 perplexity 更低，且下游 NLP benchmark 也更好。一个很关键的消融是：最好的收益出现在只对约 20% 的中间层做 recurrence/looping，而不是全层递归。这说明收益并不来自“多加一条状态通路”本身，而是来自把递归放在合适的层段。论文还把规模扩到 361M 和 1B 参数、50B pretraining tokens，收益仍然存在，说明不是小模型特有现象。

第三块是下游推理微调。作者在 GSM-Aug、ProsQA、HotPotQA、Variable Assignment 上都报告了优于参数和数据匹配基线的结果。这里最有信息量的观察不是单个 benchmark 提升多少，而是 middle-layer recurrence 变体持续优于 full-layer recurrence。也就是说，论文的核心架构判断在多个任务上都被重复验证了。

第四块是 retrofit 实验，这也是最接近实际采用场景的一部分。作者把递归路径插入到预训练好的 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct，再做短暂数学数据微调。结果 GSM8K 从 35.8 提升到 39.9，MATH500 从 12.8 提升到 18.0，且对照组是“同样微调但没有递归改造”的基线。这个结果说明 T^2MLR 不一定要求从头预训练，至少在已有模型上加一条中层递归支路也能带来可见收益。

成本方面，论文给出的推理额外开销最多约 8% per-token，这一点很关键。因为很多 latent reasoning 或 depth recurrence 方法的主要问题不是无效，而是推理成本太高，难以进入真实 serving。T^2MLR 的 trade-off 是把更多复杂性放在训练端，换取较低的在线开销。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里对问题的拆解，再直接看方法部分关于“为什么递归要放在中层”的论证。这篇文章真正有价值的地方不是门控公式，而是层功能分工与时间递归位置选择的结合。精读时重点看三类内容。

第一，架构图和 recurrence/fusion 的定义。要弄清楚缓存的是哪一层、注入到哪一层、门控如何做、是否共享参数、缓存张量的形状和更新时机是什么。这里决定了它到底是“轻量跨 token 状态”还是“变相加深网络”。

第二，训练部分的 approximate temporal-parallel scheme。这是全文最值得深挖的工程点。要重点看它如何在 teacher forcing 下近似递归依赖、误差来自哪里、是否会造成 train-test mismatch、以及 sequence parallel 的实现边界。如果你关心大规模预训练可行性，这部分比 benchmark 分数更重要。

第三，消融实验。尤其要看 middle-only recurrence vs full-layer recurrence、不同递归层段比例、与 looped transformer/latent recurrent baseline 的对比、以及推理 overhead 的测量。这里能回答“为什么不是全层递归”“为什么不是单 token 内多循环”这两个关键问题。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：方法图 + 训练近似 + 预训练主表 + 层位点消融 + retrofit 实验。预计精读 60–90 分钟比较合适；如果要评估是否能复现或改造成自家模型，训练并行化细节需要再多花一轮时间。
summary.authors_note: Princeton 相关团队，代码仓库挂在 princeton-pli 名下。摘要与正文片段未完整列出作者名单，无法在当前材料中可靠确认具体作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific architectural bottleneck in autoregressive Transformers: rich intermediate computation is repeatedly compressed back into token space at every decoding step, so abstract reasoning states do not persist well across time. Prior latent-reasoning approaches usually pass recurrent information through embeddings or final-layer outputs, which is a poor match to the empirical observation that abstract reasoning is concentrated in middle layers. Depth-looping alternatives increase per-token compute by reusing layers multiple times, but their inference cost grows with the number of loops. T^2MLR asks whether a Transformer can preserve and evolve latent reasoning states directly in the middle of the network, while keeping standard teacher-forced pretraining and near-standard decoding cost.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it makes a concrete architectural claim about where persistent reasoning state should live: in middle layers rather than at the input interface or only near the output. That aligns well with mechanistic findings on layer specialization. Second, it offers a latent-reasoning design that remains compatible with dense token-level supervision and scalable teacher-forced pretraining, which is where many continuous-CoT style ideas become impractical. Third, the gains are not confined to synthetic tasks: they carry over to language pretraining, downstream reasoning finetuning, and even a retrofit setting on a pretrained 1.7B instruct model. That makes it more than a benchmark trick. It looks like a plausible architectural branch for future base models, even if it is not yet a replacement for standard AR Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is temporal middle-layer recurrence. The model caches a representation from a deeper middle layer at token t-1 and injects it into an earlier middle layer at token t through a gated fusion pathway. This creates a continuous latent channel across decoding steps, but places that channel inside the part of the network where abstract computation is believed to happen.

Two design choices matter. First, the recurrent signal does not re-enter through the embedding layer. It is fused directly into the middle of the computation graph, so the previous token’s abstract state can continue evolving in the current token’s middle-layer processing. Second, recurrence is localized to a subset of middle layers rather than applied everywhere. The rationale is functional: early layers are more lexical/syntactic, late layers are closer to vocabulary projection, and middle layers are the best place to preserve reasoning state.

Architecturally, T^2MLR defines a write location and a read location. A hidden state from the write layer is cached, then consumed at the read layer of the next token. A gating module controls how much of the current token’s local representation should be mixed with the carried-over latent state. This is more flexible than a plain residual addition because the model can decide contextually when to rely on persistent latent state and when to ignore it.

The training story is a major part of the contribution. Exact temporal recurrence would introduce token-to-token dependencies under teacher forcing and break standard sequence-parallel training. The paper proposes an approximate temporal-parallel training scheme that preserves scalable parallelism while still training the recurrent pathway. This is the practical enabler: without it, the architecture would behave more like an RNN-style serial model and would be hard to pretrain at scale. The approximation introduces a train-time compromise between recurrence fidelity and throughput, and that trade-off is central to evaluating the method.

Relative to prior work, the distinctions are clean. Compared with latent-recurrent methods, recurrence is placed in the middle layers rather than at the input side. Compared with looped/depth-recurrent Transformers, extra computation is propagated across time instead of repeatedly re-running the full stack for one token, so inference overhead stays small. Compared with a standard Transformer, the model adds an explicit continuous hidden-state pathway across tokens, reducing the token bottleneck.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is broad and well structured.

First, the paper uses the synthetic S5-Retrieval benchmark, which combines non-solvable group state tracking with in-context retrieval. The point is not benchmark coverage but mechanism stress-testing: standard Transformers and recurrent models fail in isolation, while a shallow T^2MLR can solve the task. Even without focusing on the exact number, this result supports the claim that middle-layer temporal recurrence can maintain abstract state across steps.

Second, in language pretraining, T^2MLR achieves lower perplexity than parameter- and data-matched Transformer baselines and also improves downstream NLP benchmarks. A particularly informative ablation is that the best gains come from applying recurrence to only about 20% of the middle layers rather than the full stack. That strongly suggests the benefit comes from placing recurrence in the right region, not from adding generic extra machinery. The paper also scales experiments to 361M and 1B parameters with 50B pretraining tokens, and the gains persist.

Third, in downstream reasoning finetuning, the model consistently beats matched baselines on GSM-Aug, ProsQA, HotPotQA, and Variable Assignment. The most important pattern is not any single benchmark delta, but the repeated finding that middle-layer recurrence outperforms full-layer recurrence. That reinforces the paper’s central architectural thesis.

Fourth, the retrofit experiment is practically important. The authors insert the recurrent pathway into a pretrained SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct model and do brief math finetuning. GSM8K improves from 35.8 to 39.9, and MATH500 from 12.8 to 18.0, compared with an identically finetuned baseline without the recurrent modification. This suggests the architecture may be adoptable without full pretraining from scratch.

On efficiency, the paper reports at most about 8% extra per-token inference overhead. That matters because many latent-reasoning or depth-looping methods fail the deployment test due to decoding cost. T^2MLR shifts more complexity to training while keeping online overhead modest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem framing in the introduction, then move quickly to the method section that argues why recurrence should live in the middle layers. The main value is not the gating formula by itself, but the combination of layer specialization and temporal recurrence.

Three parts deserve close reading. First, inspect the architecture figure and the exact recurrence/fusion definition: which layer writes the cache, which layer reads it, how the gate is parameterized, whether parameters are shared, what tensor is cached, and when it is updated. Those details determine whether this is truly a lightweight cross-token latent state or just another way of deepening the network.

Second, study the approximate temporal-parallel training scheme. This is the most important engineering contribution. Focus on how teacher-forced recurrence is approximated, where the approximation error comes from, whether it creates train-test mismatch, and how it interacts with sequence parallelism. If large-scale pretraining feasibility is your main concern, this section matters more than the benchmark tables.

Third, read the ablations carefully: middle-only versus full-layer recurrence, the fraction of layers used for recurrence, comparisons against looped Transformers and latent-recurrent baselines, and the inference overhead measurements. These experiments answer the two key design questions: why not recur everywhere, and why not just loop depth within a token.

If time is limited, the best path is: method figure, training approximation, main pretraining table, layer-placement ablations, and the retrofit experiment. A serious read is about 60–90 minutes; reproducing or adapting the method would require another pass over the training-parallelism details.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Princeton-related authors; the code repository is under princeton-pli. The provided material does not include a reliable full author list, so individual author backgrounds cannot be confirmed here.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动摇“AR 推理状态只能靠 token 传递”的 prior，先看 recurrence 插入位置和 retrofit 实验；若结果稳，内部应立刻做中层状态通路 ablation。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that AR models can only pass reasoning state through tokens; start with the recurrence placement and retrofit results, and reproduce the middle-state pathway ablation internally.

paper.title: Targeted Recovery of Weight-Space Mechanisms From Neural Networks
paper.abstract: Parameter decomposition (PD) decomposes neural networks into interpretable computational components that faithfully reflect the original network's operations. However, scaling PD to large models requires vast compute, making it a costly and risky endeavor. Here we propose targeted PD (tPD), which identifies only the components that process specific inputs of interest -- from isolated prompts to large subtasks -- by introducing a high-rank catch-all component that handles all non-target data. We

summary.core_problem: 现有参数分解（PD）方法需要对模型全量分解，计算成本极高，难以扩展到大模型；仅用目标数据做分解会导致解欠定，提取的组件在非目标输入上行为不可预测，无法保证机制忠实性。
summary.importance: 大幅降低了权重空间机制分解的计算成本，使得在中等规模甚至更大的LLM上做特定任务/特定输入的电路级分析成为可能；为预训练模型的可解释性、模型编辑、特定能力的底层电路验证提供了更实用的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 提出靶向参数分解（tPD），核心是引入高秩兜底组件Δ处理所有非目标数据，仅对目标数据相关的机制做稀疏秩-1分解。具体设计：1. 训练使用两个并行数据流：目标数据集（待解释的输入子集）和从原训练分布采样的非目标数据集。2. 对目标数据，仅用稀疏秩-1子组件重构输出，这些子组件只需捕获目标数据上激活的机制，无需还原全部权重。3. 对非目标数据，用原权重与子组件和的残差（即满秩Δ组件）重构，Δ捕获所有不在目标数据上激活的机制。4. 训练时在目标批次上对抗性消融Δ（随机0-100%比例），迫使目标输出完全由子组件重构；非目标批次上Δ始终启用。5. 同时对非激活组件和Δ做对抗性消融，保证分解电路的机制忠实性——任意混合原矩阵和消融矩阵时模型输出不变。
summary.experiments: 1. 玩具模型TMCC上，靶向分解3个输入特征仅需5个秩-1子组件槽位（全量分解需100个），收敛步数从~2500步降至~500步，可准确恢复对应3个机制，且子组件不会在非目标输入上虚假激活。2. 在训练于The Pile的4层Transformer（28M非嵌入参数）上，以两个Python import prompt为目标的分解在不同随机种子下高度一致（V向量余弦相似度很高），且满足telescoping一致性（A∪B的分解等于A、B分解的并集）。3. 4层Transformer的CSS子模型分解仅需全量分解~7%的FLOPs，方法可扩展到12层Transformer。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2节方法部分，关注Δ兜底组件和对抗性消融的设计逻辑；玩具模型验证可快速浏览，Transformer实验部分重点看种子一致性和telescoping一致性的结果。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Full parameter decomposition (PD) of neural networks requires prohibitive compute for large models, making scaling to frontier LLMs impractical. Naive decomposition using only target data leads to underdetermined solutions, where extracted components have unpredictable behavior on non-target inputs and lack mechanistic faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: Targeted PD drastically reduces the compute cost of weight-space mechanistic analysis, making circuit-level investigation of specific capabilities or input subsets feasible on medium-to-large LLMs. It provides a practical tool for interpretability, model editing, and verification of underlying circuits for specific capabilities in pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Targeted Parameter Decomposition (tPD) introduces a high-rank catch-all component Δ that handles all non-target data, so only mechanisms active on the target subset need to be explicitly decomposed into sparse rank-1 subcomponents. Key design details: 1. Training uses two parallel data streams: a small target dataset (inputs to be explained) and a non-target stream sampled from the model's original training distribution. 2. For target data, outputs are reconstructed using only a sparse set of rank-1 subcomponents, which capture mechanisms active on the target and do not need to sum to the full original weights. 3. For non-target data, outputs are reconstructed using the full-rank Δ component, defined as the residual between the original weights and the sum of target subcomponents; Δ captures all mechanisms never active on target data. 4. During training, Δ is adversarially ablated (0–100% of parameters) on target batches to force target outputs to be reconstructed solely from the sparse subcomponents; Δ is always enabled on non-target batches. 5. Both inactive subcomponents and Δ are adversarially ablated to ensure mechanistic faithfulness — model outputs remain unchanged for any hybrid of original and ablated weight matrices.
summary_en.experiments: 1. On the TMCC toy model, tPD targeting 3 input features requires only 5 rank-1 subcomponent slots (vs. 100 for full PD) and converges in ~500 steps (vs. ~2500 for full PD), while accurately recovering the 3 corresponding mechanisms with no spurious activation on non-target inputs. 2. On a 4-block transformer (28M non-embedding parameters, trained on The Pile), tPD targeting two Python import prompts produces highly consistent decompositions across random seeds (high cosine similarity of V vectors), and satisfies telescoping consistency (decomposition of A∪B equals the union of decompositions of A and B). 3. Extracting a CSS-only submodel from the 4-block transformer uses ~7% of the FLOPs required for full published decomposition; the method scales to 12-block transformers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (method) for the core design of the Δ catch-all component and adversarial ablation scheme. Skim the toy model validation; for transformer experiments, prioritize seed consistency and telescoping consistency results. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 靶向权重分解的思路实用，做预训练机制分析（如记忆、特定能力电路）可参考，重点看§3的tPD形式化和§4的Transformer实验
recommendation.en: Targeted weight decomposition is practical for pretraining mechanism analysis (e.g., memory, capability circuits); focus on §3 for tPD formulation and §4 for Transformer experiments.

paper.title: Sparse Inter-Layer Dependencies of Transformer FFN Neurons
paper.abstract: Feedforward network (FFN) blocks account for a large fraction of the parameters and computation in Transformer architectures, yet their internal structure remains difficult to interpret due to the additive superposition induced by the residual stream. We examine whether the activation of an FFN neuron can be explained by a sparse set of preceding neuron activations and attention outputs. We introduce a training-free attribution method that estimates the relative influence of upstream neurons and

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 中 FFN 神经元的激活是否主要由少量上游神经元和注意力输出决定，从而刻画跨层依赖的稀疏性。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解 FFN 的有效自由度、残差流中的可解释性，以及未来做结构化剪枝/稀疏化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种 training-free attribution 方法，估计某个目标 FFN 神经元对前序层神经元激活和 attention 输出的相对依赖。核心检验是：仅保留少量被选中的上游输入，其余输入用平均值替代，看目标神经元激活能否高保真重建；进一步把这种 neuron-specific mask 同时施加到所有层，观察整体模型行为偏移。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖多个模型和层，发现少量上游激活与 attention 输出即可较好保留目标神经元激活；若再考虑上游层本身的激活稀疏性，有效依赖更稀疏。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和与其他 attribution 方法的定量对比幅度。
summary.authors_note: Hanspeter Pfister 是 Harvard 的资深可视化与机器学习研究者。该工作更偏可解释性与结构分析，而非大规模预训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether FFN neuron activations in Transformers are largely determined by a small set of upstream neurons and attention outputs, thereby revealing sparse inter-layer dependencies.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability paper. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is relevant for understanding FFN effective degrees of freedom, interpretability under residual mixing, and possible future pruning or sparsification directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a training-free attribution method that estimates how much a target FFN neuron depends on preceding neuron activations and attention outputs. The key test is to keep only a small selected subset of upstream inputs while replacing the rest with average values, then measure how well the target activation is preserved. They also apply neuron-specific masks across all layers simultaneously to test model-level robustness.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments span multiple models and layers and show that small subsets of upstream activations and attention outputs can preserve target neuron activations with high fidelity. Effective sparsity becomes even stronger when upstream activation sparsity is taken into account. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes, datasets, or quantitative comparisons to other attribution methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Hanspeter Pfister is a senior Harvard researcher known for visualization and machine learning. The work is more about interpretability and structural analysis than large-scale pretraining experiments.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 FFN 是否真需要这么 dense，这篇能给一点硬证据；先看方法设定和跨层同时加 mask 的实验，别急着外推到可训练稀疏架构。
recommendation.en: If you are questioning how dense FFNs really need to be, this gives useful evidence; read the attribution setup and the all-layer masking result, but do not overgeneralize it into trainable sparse architectures yet.

paper.title: AutoNorm: Understanding Adaptive Normalization in Transformers through Differentiable Gating
paper.abstract: Normalization is a critical component for stabilizing Transformer training, yet the choice between static strategies such as Layer Normalization (LN) and adaptive alternatives remains largely task-dependent. In this paper, we investigate a key optimization challenge in differentiable normalization gating. Our experiments show that, on relatively stationary vision tasks, the high gradient variance introduced by Gumbel-Softmax gating can hinder convergence of the routing mechanism, causing learned

summary.core_problem: 如何在 Transformer 中用可微的“归一化路由/选择”机制（在 LN 与 DyT 等候选归一化之间按层自适应切换）稳定训练，并解释为什么同一套 gating 在语言任务上有效、在相对平稳的视觉任务上却会失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练的直接价值在于“训练稳定性与训练动态”的一类具体机制：可微结构选择（Gumbel-Softmax gating）在不同数据非平稳性条件下会出现完全不同的优化行为。论文把失败归因到早期高梯度方差导致 selector 无法及时专化，并给出一个工程上可落地的稳定化策略（gate-freezing schedule）。这类结论对大规模预训练里引入可学习路由（MoE、可学习算子选择、可学习归一化/激活）时的 recipe 设计有参考意义，但方法本身更偏“组件级改造”，影响量级取决于是否真的需要在线自适应归一化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法主线是 AutoNorm：在每一层把归一化从“固定 LN”改为“在 LN 与 DyT 之间做可学习混合/选择”。权重由一个轻量 NormSelector 预测，并用 Gumbel–Softmax 重参数化实现近似离散路由，从而可以端到端反传优化。

全文的关键不是“又一个可学习混合”，而是对失败模式的定位：在输入分布较平稳（stationary）的任务上，训练早期 backbone 表征尚未成形，selector 的梯度方差又很高，导致 gating 分布难以收敛到稳定偏好，最终学到的路由甚至不如随机选择；而在语言建模/分类这类更非平稳的设置里，gating 多样性可以持续存在更久，反而给 selector 足够时间在表征成熟后形成有效的层级策略。

对应的改进是 AutoNorm-S：引入 gate-freezing schedule（按训练阶段冻结/放开 gate 或其温度/采样噪声的控制），核心目的是降低早期 selector 的优化噪声，让 backbone 先进入“可分辨”的表征区间，再让路由专化。论文也把“非平稳性”操作化为训练过程中激活统计的跨 batch 变化、以及 gating 分布熵的坍缩速度等可观测信号，用来解释何时 adaptive normalization 更可能带来收益。
summary.experiments:
从全文描述看，实验围绕三点展开：
1) 复现与对比：AutoNorm（Gumbel-Softmax gating）在视觉基准上出现 selector 学不好、性能不如 Random Selector 的反直觉现象；在语言建模/分类任务上则能学到更好的层级归一化策略。
2) 机制验证：用梯度方差、gating 熵/多样性随训练演化等指标，展示“平稳数据 + 早期高方差”会阻碍路由专化。
3) 修复效果：AutoNorm-S 通过 gate-freezing 恢复视觉任务上的竞争力，并在 NLP 上提供额外 inductive bias。

你给到的全文片段未包含表格与具体数值（模型规模、数据规模、提升幅度），因此无法可靠摘录精确数字；若需要数字级结论，需要补充 Table/Figure 所在页或 PDF。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“视觉失败、语言成功”的现象描述，明确论文要解释的是优化动力学而不是归一化公式本身。
- 重点看 Methodology 中对“non-stationarity”的定义与可观测量（激活统计变化、gating 熵坍缩），这是全文论证链条的支点。
- 直接跳到 AutoNorm-S 的 gate-freezing 细节（训练日程如何设、冻结哪些参数/温度），这是最可迁移的工程经验。
- 最后看实验里 Random Selector vs learned gating 的对照，以及与 SwitchNorm / DyT / LN 的对比设置，确认收益是否来自“路由”而非单一归一化更强。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make differentiable normalization routing in Transformers train reliably—i.e., learning per-layer policies to switch between LN and alternatives like DyT—and why the same Gumbel-Softmax gating works on language tasks but fails on relatively stationary vision tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics explanation for differentiable architectural selection: with stationary inputs, early-stage high gradient variance in Gumbel-Softmax gating prevents the selector from specializing before backbone features mature, so learned routing can underperform even random selection. The proposed stabilization (a gate-freezing schedule) is a practical recipe that may generalize to other learnable routing components used in pretraining (e.g., operator selection, conditional computation). The impact is component-level rather than a new pretraining paradigm, but the failure-mode analysis is the part worth keeping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AutoNorm replaces a fixed normalization (typically LN) with a learnable mixture/selection between LN and DyT at each Transformer layer. A lightweight NormSelector predicts mixture weights, trained end-to-end via a Gumbel–Softmax reparameterization to approximate discrete routing.

The paper’s technical core is the diagnosis of when this routing is learnable: on stationary datasets, the selector sees high-variance gradients early on while representations are still unstable, so the gating distribution does not collapse into meaningful preferences; on non-stationary language modeling/classification, sustained gating diversity persists long enough for the selector to discover useful layer-wise policies after representations become informative.

AutoNorm-S addresses this with a gate-freezing schedule (and related control of gating noise/temperature): reduce selector degrees of freedom early to let the backbone settle, then re-enable routing to allow specialization. The work also operationalizes “non-stationarity” using measurable signals such as batch-to-batch activation-statistics variability and the entropy-collapse rate of the gating distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three pillars:
1) Phenomenon: differentiable Gumbel-Softmax gating learns effective normalization policies on language tasks but can fail on vision benchmarks, where a Random Selector may outperform the learned gates.
2) Mechanism: tracking gradient-variance and gating-entropy dynamics supports the claim that early high-variance gradients block specialization under stationary inputs.
3) Fix: AutoNorm-S (gate-freezing) restores competitive performance on vision and provides an inductive bias on NLP.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the tables/figures with exact numbers (model sizes, data sizes, deltas), so I cannot quote reliable numeric improvements without the missing pages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the key empirical anomaly (vision failure vs language success) and the hypothesis about optimization dynamics.
- Focus on the Methodology section where non-stationarity is defined and measured; this is the backbone of the argument.
- Jump to the AutoNorm-S gate-freezing schedule details; this is the most transferable training recipe.
- Check the main ablations comparing learned gating vs random selection and against LN/DyT/SwitchNorm baselines to ensure the gains are truly from routing rather than a stronger single normalization.

recommendation.zh: 自适应归一化的跨任务优化差异分析有参考价值，重点看梯度方差与门控收敛的关联实验，可纳入预训练归一化消融备选。
recommendation.en: The cross-task optimization analysis of adaptive normalization is informative; focus on experiments linking gradient variance to gating convergence, worth considering for pretraining normalization ablations.

paper.title: Legible-by-Construction: Attention and End-to-End Transformers
paper.abstract: A companion paper showed that a transformer's feed-forward layer can be rebuilt from explicit fuzzy set operations - intersection, set-difference, and a self-forgetting sequence quantifier - so its hidden units read as named logical operators at no cost to language-model quality. That left the other half of the transformer opaque. Here we carry the same idea into attention and join the two into one model. The mechanism is minimal: a head's value is passed through a sigmoid, so each value channel

summary.core_problem: 论文试图让 Transformer 的 attention 路径在结构上更可读，而不是训练后再用 probing、logit lens 或 sparse autoencoder 解释。核心问题是 attention 的 QK 路径相对容易理解为“看哪里”，但 OV 路径很难解释为“写什么”。作者提出把 value 通道约束成可读的模糊集合成员关系，同时保持输出投影自由。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与机制解释交界的工作。它的价值不在语言建模指标提升，而在提出一种可训练的可解释 attention 设计：约束检测对象，不约束写入方式。这个原则对预训练研究有启发，因为很多可解释性约束会损伤模型容量，或者给优化器留下无意义捷径。这里的设计尝试保留标准 attention 的主要自由度，只在 value 上加 sigmoid 边界和选择性压力，让通道更像“某个特征是否成立”的检测器。
summary.technical_approach: 主要改动是将每个 head 的 value 写成 v = sigmoid(W_v x)，把 value channel 限制在 [0, 1]，解释为 fuzzy membership。attention 对这些 membership 做上下文聚合，输出投影仍然完全自由。这个 bounded-value / free-readout 设计是关键：如果反过来约束输出写入，例如把 head output 绑到词表空间，模型可能走上下文无关常量的梯度捷径，表面可读但没有实际选择性。论文还讨论 Boolean variant，把 value 进一步组织成显式的 within-token intersection 与 set-difference，使 OV 路径更接近逻辑操作。训练上加入两类压力：sparsity 让检测器只在少数上下文触发，crispness 让激活靠近 0 或 1。不同设计需要不同正则：单一 membership value 需要 sparsity 和 crispness；显式 conjunction 已经天然稀疏，更适合只加 crispness，否则容易变成死通道。
summary.experiments: 实验在 125M 参数规模上比较五种 specialized-attention 设计。结果显示，bounded value 设计中有 44% 到 62% 的 value channels 形成清晰、上下文选择性的检测器；与之对比，vocabulary-tied 设计出现 constant-collapse。层深也有明显影响：最深层可选择通道比例达到 70% 到 95%，并能读出较稳定的语义和语法特征，例如抽象概念、领域、人物/复数相关通道。论文还报告该 attention 设计可以和 companion work 中的 legible FFN 合并成端到端 Transformer，并声称没有牺牲语言模型质量。最有信息量的消融是约束位置和正则位置：约束 value 而不是 output，正则 operands 而不是组合后的 operator output。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 QK/OV 可读性差异的分析，再看 Section 3 关于为什么不能约束 write/output，尤其是 vocabulary-tied 设计的失败原因。Section 3.6 和 Section 4 是重点：前者解释 sparsity、crispness 应该施加在哪里，后者给出 125M 模型上各设计的选择性比例和通道示例。若关心可解释架构是否能扩展到大模型，需要额外检查训练开销、困惑度对比、正则强度敏感性，以及这些通道在更大数据规模下是否仍保持可读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the opacity of the attention OV path. QK patterns are relatively interpretable as where a head attends, while the value and output path is much harder to read as what the head contributes. The goal is to make attention legible by construction rather than relying only on post-hoc interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits between architecture design and mechanistic interpretability. Its main lesson for pretraining researchers is about where to place interpretability constraints. Constraining the detector side of a head can make channels readable while preserving a free output projection; constraining the write side can create optimization shortcuts and collapse to context-independent behavior. This is a useful design principle for building models whose internal units are easier to inspect without directly tying them to vocabulary outputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core modification is minimal: replace the raw value with a bounded membership value, v = sigmoid(W_v x), so each value channel lies in [0, 1] and can be interpreted as whether a feature holds at the token. Attention then aggregates these memberships over context, while the output projection remains unconstrained. This bounded-value/free-readout split is the central mechanism. The paper also studies a Boolean variant in which values are structured as explicit within-token intersections and set differences, mirroring the legible FFN operators from the companion work. Training uses two pressures: sparsity, to make detectors fire only in selected contexts, and crispness, to push activations toward 0 or 1. The paper emphasizes that the pressure must match the operator: a single membership value benefits from both, while an explicit conjunction is already sparse and mainly needs crispness.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use 125M-parameter models and compare five specialized attention designs. In the bounded-value designs, 44% to 62% of value channels become crisp and context-selective, whereas the vocabulary-tied design collapses to constants. Selectivity increases with depth: the deepest layers reach 70% to 95% selective channels, with interpretable examples tied to semantic and grammatical features such as abstract concepts, domains, and people/plural distinctions. The paper also combines legible attention with the earlier legible FFN into an end-to-end Transformer and reports no language-model quality loss. The important ablations concern the location of the constraint and regularization: constrain the value, not the output; regularize operator operands, not only the combined output.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction for the QK-versus-OV framing. Then read Section 3 for the failure mode of constraining the write/output path, especially the vocabulary-tied shortcut. Sections 3.6 and 4 are the most useful parts: they explain the sparsity/crispness pressures and show the 125M-scale channel selectivity results. For deeper follow-up, inspect perplexity trade-offs, sensitivity to regularization strength, and whether the same legibility survives larger models and broader pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它在“attention 可解释性要约束哪里”上给了清楚立场；先看方法假设和可视化，性能结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it makes a clean claim about where interpretability constraints should live in attention; read the construction and visual evidence first, treat the quality claim as provisional.

paper.title: Sequential Correlations Change In-Context Learning: Effective Context Length and Architectural Mismatch
paper.abstract: Modern sequence models have a striking capacity for in-context learning (ICL); they can perform new tasks based only on examples given in the prompt. Understanding how this ability emerges requires theory that captures important properties of natural data. Linear regression has served as a useful sandbox for ICL theory, but existing work has largely focused on prompts with independent examples. In this work, we extend this setting to sequentially correlated data, a basic feature of real sequence

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究顺序相关性如何改变 in-context linear regression 中的 ICL 行为。过去的理论通常假设 prompt 内样本独立同分布，但真实语言序列有明显的局部相关和长程相关。论文把这个缺口拆成两个问题：上下文样本之间相关会不会降低可用样本数；query 与上下文相关时，模型是否会利用这部分额外统计信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它给 ICL 的“有效上下文长度”提供了一个可分析的例子。长上下文不等于有效样本数线性增加；如果 token 或样本高度相关，模型看到的上下文更长，但独立信息量可能更少。这个结论对长上下文预训练、数据去重、序列打包、curriculum 以及 ICL 机制分析都有参考意义。论文也指出，当 query 相关统计进入推理过程时，不同注意力架构之间的差异会被放大，这对解释 transformer 为什么能利用自然序列结构有一定价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从可解的 reduced-parameter linear attention 模型出发，在 in-context linear regression 中引入 sequence correlation kernel。设置上区分两类相关性：一类只存在于上下文样本之间，query 仍与上下文独立；另一类让 query 与前文按同样统计结构相关。第一种设置用于分析相关样本如何等价于更短的 i.i.d. prompt，形成 effective context length。第二种设置用于观察模型能否把 query-context correlation 当作额外信号用于预测。论文还把 reduced linear attention 的理论曲线拿到更真实的 full-parameter linear attention 和 softmax attention with MLP 上验证，观察理论是否能解释架构更复杂时的趋势。与常见 i.i.d. ICL 理论相比，核心变化不是换任务，而是把序列相关性作为数据生成过程的一部分纳入分析。
summary.experiments: 关键实验比较三类模型：reduced-parameter linear attention、full-parameter linear attention、softmax attention with MLP。图 1 显示，当 query 独立而上下文内部相关增强时，ICL test loss 上升；这个趋势可以由 effective context length 近似解释，即相关 prompt 的表现接近更短的非相关 prompt。当 query 也与上下文相关时，三类模型的 test loss 均下降，说明模型能利用 query 周围的相关信息，而不是只执行标准的线性回归估计。实验还显示 softmax attention with MLP 与 linear attention 的差距在 query-dependent statistics 出现后变大，说明相关数据会暴露架构归纳偏置差异。论文还讨论了一个理论边界：如果相关长度随 context length 增长，高维集中假设可能失效，linear attention estimator 的矩不再稳定集中。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和 Figure 1，先抓住两个主结论：上下文相关导致有效样本数减少；query-context 相关可被模型利用并降低误差。之后看理论设置中 correlation kernel、effective context length 的推导，以及高维近似失效条件。实验部分重点看 reduced linear attention 理论曲线与 full linear attention、softmax attention 的对照。预计阅读 30–45 分钟即可获得主要启发；如果关心 ICL 理论或长上下文数据效率，可进一步细读推导和 appendix 中的实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how sequential correlations alter in-context linear regression. Most ICL theory assumes independent examples inside a prompt, while natural sequences contain local and long-range dependence. The work separates two effects: correlations among context examples, and correlations between the query and its preceding context.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is a clean analysis of effective context length. A longer context does not necessarily provide proportionally more independent evidence; correlated tokens can behave like a shorter i.i.d. prompt. This matters for long-context pretraining, packing strategies, deduplication, curriculum design, and mechanistic accounts of ICL. The paper also shows that query-dependent statistics amplify architectural differences, which is useful for understanding why some attention variants exploit sequence structure better than others.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from a solvable reduced-parameter linear attention model for in-context linear regression and adds a sequence correlation kernel. The setup distinguishes context-only correlations from query-context correlations. In the first case, the query remains independent, so the main effect is a reduction in the number of effectively independent examples. In the second case, the query shares the same sequential structure as the context, giving the model additional information for inference. The theoretical predictions are then compared against fuller architectures, including full-parameter linear attention and a softmax-attention model with an MLP. The contribution is not a new downstream task, but a controlled way to insert realistic sequence dependence into ICL theory.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments compare reduced-parameter linear attention, full-parameter linear attention, and softmax attention with an MLP. Figure 1 shows that context-only correlations increase ICL test loss, and that the degradation is well approximated by replacing the correlated prompt with an uncorrelated prompt of shorter effective length. When the query is correlated with the context, test loss drops across all model classes, indicating that the models exploit the added statistical structure. The gap between linear attention and softmax attention becomes larger in this regime, suggesting an architectural mismatch that is hidden in the i.i.d. setting. The paper also identifies a failure mode of the high-dimensional treatment: when the correlation length scales with context length, the effective number of independent examples may stop scaling with dimension, and estimator moments may fail to concentrate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and Figure 1 first; they contain the two central takeaways. Then read the model setup for the correlation kernel and the derivation of effective context length. The most useful technical parts are the comparison between theory and the three architectures, plus the discussion of when high-dimensional concentration breaks down. Expected reading time is about 30–45 minutes; readers focused on ICL theory or long-context data efficiency may want to spend more time on the derivations and appendix experiments.

recommendation.zh: ICL机制研究的增量工作，重点看有效上下文长度的量化推导，对预训练数据的序列构造有微弱参考价值。
recommendation.en: Incremental ICL mechanism work; focus on the effective context length quantification, with minor implications for pretraining data sequence design.

paper.title: Zeus: Towards Tuning-Free Foundation Model for Time Series Analysis
paper.abstract: We present Zeus, a unified tuning-free Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM) that delivers superior performance across diverse analysis tasks without any task-specific fine-tuning. Unlike prior studies that primarily focus on zero-shot forecasting but require task-specific tuning for other tasks, Zeus bridges this gap by addressing two fundamental challenges in multi-task generalization. First, to reconcile point-level granularity with long-sequence scalability, Zeus incorporates a multi-scale Tra

summary.core_problem: 现有时间序列基础模型多聚焦零样本预测，其他任务需任务特定微调，且难以同时兼顾点级粒度与长序列扩展性、不同任务的归纳偏置差异。
summary.importance: 范式创新，提出首个无需任务微调的通用时间序列基础模型，统一支持外推、内插、全局抽象等多种异构时间序列任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Zeus框架，核心包括两点：1）多尺度Transformer，采用点级token化和U形层次结构，平衡细粒度保真度与计算效率；2）多目标时间掩码（MOTM），通过统一预训练目标支持异构任务。
summary.experiments: 在五类代表性时间序列任务上开展实验，结果显示Zeus性能一致优于现有基线方法（摘要截断，具体提升幅度未完全披露）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing time series foundation models mostly focus on zero-shot forecasting, require task-specific fine-tuning for other tasks, and struggle to balance point-level granularity with long-sequence scalability and inductive bias differences across tasks.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation: the first tuning-free unified time series foundation model that supports multiple heterogeneous tasks including extrapolation, interpolation, and global abstraction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Zeus framework with two core components: 1) a multi-scale Transformer with point-wise tokenization and U-shaped hierarchy, balancing fine-grained fidelity and computational efficiency; 2) Multi-Objective Temporal Masking (MOTM), enabling heterogeneous task support via a unified pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on five representative time series tasks, Zeus consistently outperforms existing baselines (abstract truncated, exact improvement margins not fully disclosed).

recommendation.zh: 时间序列领域的统一基础模型尝试，多目标掩码的思路对LLM多任务预训练有一定参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A unified foundation model attempt for time series; multi-objective masking offers minor reference for LLM multi-task pretraining, read the abstract only.

paper.title: Gradient Smoothing: Coupling Layer-wise Updates for Improved Optimization
paper.abstract: Deep neural networks with repeated architectural blocks, such as transformers, often exhibit structured relationships across layers that emerge during training. Motivated by this observation, we introduce \emph{Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation}, a general optimization paradigm in which the update applied to each layer is obtained by transforming the collection of block-wise optimizer updates along the depth dimension. Within this framework, we study \emph{Gradient Smoothing}, a family of depth-w

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注重复块网络的优化问题：Transformer、ResNet 这类模型在深度方向上会形成层间相似性，但常规优化器仍把每一层的参数更新近似独立处理，没有显式利用这种深度结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“层间耦合”从表征分析推进到优化器更新规则。方法不改模型结构，也不依赖特定优化器，可以接在 Adam、AdamW、Muon、SGD 等更新之后。对于大模型训练，这类后处理式优化增强的吸引力在于工程侵入较小，可能改善训练稳定性、收敛速度和泛化，但需要在更大规模预训练上验证收益是否能保持。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation：先由基础优化器为每个重复块产生 block-wise update，然后沿深度维度对这些更新做变换，再把变换后的更新应用到各层。具体实例是 Gradient Smoothing，尤其是 Window Smoothing：每一层的更新不只来自自身，而是与邻近若干层的优化器更新做局部平均。关键点是平滑对象是“优化器产生的 update”，不是原始梯度，因此它可以叠加在 Adam 的自适应更新、Muon 的矩阵更新或普通 SGD 之后。方法可被理解为一种块结构参数空间上的预条件器：假设相邻层的学习动态存在相关性，就用局部平滑降低层间更新噪声，并鼓励深度方向上的表示演化更连续。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖语言模型预训练、LLM 推理任务的 RL fine-tuning、Vision Transformer 监督训练和 diffusion model 训练。作者报告 Gradient Smoothing 在这些设置中能改善优化和泛化，并观察到更强的 layer-wise trajectory alignment 与 representation residual similarity。消融重点围绕不同基础优化器、局部窗口平滑以及层间表示结构变化。提供内容中没有给出具体表格数字、参数规模、训练 token 数或提升幅度，因此不应把结论外推为大规模 LLM 训练已验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看方法定义部分，确认 update-level smoothing 的数学形式，以及它和直接平滑梯度、跨层参数共享、layer tying 的区别。其次看实验中语言模型预训练和 RL fine-tuning 的设置，因为这两部分最接近基座训练问题。表示分析部分也值得扫读，重点看 trajectory alignment 和 residual similarity 是否只是相关现象，还是能解释优化收益。若要复现实验，需重点检查窗口大小、边界层处理、是否平滑 attention/MLP 全部块参数、non-block 参数如何处理，以及与 AdamW/Muon 状态更新的先后顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies an optimization gap in repeated-block networks. Transformers and ResNets develop structured relationships across depth during training, but standard optimizers still construct and apply per-layer updates largely independently.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining is that it turns layer coupling from an analysis observation into an optimizer-side intervention. The method does not change the architecture and can be placed after common optimizers such as Adam, AdamW, SGD, or Muon. This makes it engineering-light compared with architectural changes. For large-scale pretraining, the open question is whether the reported gains survive at larger model and token scales, especially under tightly tuned optimizer recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation. A base optimizer first produces block-wise updates for all repeated layers. A depth-wise operator then transforms this collection of updates before applying them to the model. The concrete instantiation is Gradient Smoothing, with Window Smoothing as the simplest operator: each layer receives a local average of optimizer updates from neighboring layers. The smoothing is applied to optimizer updates rather than raw gradients, which is why the method can be composed with adaptive optimizers and matrix-based optimizers. Conceptually, it behaves like a structured preconditioner over a block-structured parameter space, using the assumption that nearby layers often follow related learning dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments span language model pretraining, RL fine-tuning of LLMs for reasoning, supervised Vision Transformer training, and diffusion model training. The paper reports consistent improvements in optimization and generalization, together with stronger layer-wise trajectory alignment and higher residual representation similarity across depth. The provided content does not include exact table values, parameter counts, token budgets, or improvement magnitudes, so the evidence should be read as promising but not yet sufficient to settle large-scale LLM pretraining behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Start with the formal definition of Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation and Window Smoothing, focusing on the distinction between update smoothing and gradient smoothing. Then inspect the language model pretraining and RL fine-tuning experiments, since these are closest to foundation-model training. The representation analysis is worth reading to see whether alignment metrics plausibly explain the optimization gains. For implementation, pay attention to window size, boundary handling, whether attention and MLP parameters are smoothed together or separately, how non-block parameters are treated, and whether optimizer states are updated before or after smoothing.

recommendation.zh: 一种非常简单但有效的 trick，利用了 Transformer 层间的相似性进行梯度平滑，建议在内部 pretrain 实验中快速验证其对收敛速度的提升。
recommendation.en: A simple yet effective trick that leverages inter-layer similarity in Transformers for gradient smoothing; worth a quick validation in internal pretrain runs for convergence speedup.

paper.title: CHERRY: Compressed Hierarchical Experts with Recurrent Representational Yield
paper.abstract: We study three complementary techniques for training compute-efficient language models.   (1) Selective supervision and per-token efficiency. Selective Ground Truth Token Training (SGT) concentrates supervision on the ~15% of output tokens that carry semantic payload. Through positive gradient coupling in position-shared transformer weights -- a token-level instance of auxiliary-task transfer -- the remaining 85% of unsupervised tokens still improve substantially, giving a 4.5x per-supervised-to

summary.core_problem: 在训练和参数预算受限时，如何用更少监督、更浅网络和更紧凑表示维持语言模型学习效率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是标准 recipe 微调，而是在监督稀疏化、深度压缩和循环恢复三个方向同时动手，试图改写“每个 token 都要监督、深层堆叠不可少”的默认做法，对预训练效率研究有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，Selective Ground Truth Token Training 只对约 15% 语义负载更高的 token 施加监督，依赖共享 Transformer 权重带来的正梯度耦合，让未监督 token 也随之改善，并给出梯度耦合系数为正时的理论保证。第二，将 48 层 1B Transformer 压缩为 6 层 227M 主干，再通过循环式表征恢复弥补深度损失。第三，采用分层专家压缩结构，在较小参数量下保留更强表示能力。整体更像是训练效率与架构压缩的组合方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露的关键结果是：只监督 15% token 时，在 step-100 的评估最优点可恢复完整序列 loss 降幅的约 67%，对应每个被监督 token 约 4.5 倍效率；梯度耦合系数平均值约 0.72，且在打乱文本后该效应消失，说明收益依赖自然语言结构。另有从 48 层 1B 压缩到 6 层 227M 的设定，但摘要未给出完整基线和下游指标，结论可信度仍需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 TeamSparta 的 AXOps Team，不是头部实验室，但题目覆盖 selective supervision、压缩和循环恢复，偏研究型工程探索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to preserve language-model learning efficiency under limited supervision, shallower depth, and compressed parameter budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is not a standard recipe tweak. It jointly challenges the default assumption that every token needs supervision and that deep stacks are indispensable, so it is relevant to pretraining-efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines three ideas. First, Selective Ground Truth Token Training supervises only about 15% of semantically loaded tokens, relying on positive gradient coupling through shared Transformer weights so that unsupervised tokens still improve; the paper also gives a theorem for the positive-coupling regime. Second, it compresses a 48-layer 1B Transformer into a 6-layer 227M backbone and uses recurrent representational recovery to compensate for lost depth. Third, it adds a compressed hierarchical expert structure to retain capacity under a smaller parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, supervising only 15% of tokens recovers about 67% of the full-sequence loss reduction at the step-100 optimum, implying roughly 4.5x efficiency per supervised token. The average gradient-coupling coefficient is around 0.72, and the effect collapses on shuffled text, suggesting dependence on natural-language structure. The 48-layer 1B to 6-layer 227M compression setup is notable, but the abstract does not provide enough baseline detail or full downstream metrics, so the strength of the claim needs checking in the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from TeamSparta's AXOps Team. This is not a major frontier lab paper, but it reads like a research-oriented engineering exploration of selective supervision, compression, and recurrent recovery.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是 selective token supervision 这部分：若 Table/Fig 证明 15% 监督真能稳定迁移到其余 token，就该立刻做内部复现；其余压缩模块先保留怀疑。
recommendation.en: Read it for the selective-token supervision claim: if the tables really show stable transfer from 15% supervised tokens to the rest, it deserves an internal ablation; stay skeptical about the rest.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Control: State-Aware Fine-Tuning for Transformer-based Models
paper.abstract: State-based fine-tuning has emerged as a compelling alternative to weight-based adaptation for transformers, updating lightweight controls into states rather than model weights, offering substantial memory savings while retaining parameter efficiency. However, most existing state-based methods typically apply only per-block control updates, which limits inter-block information exchange and restricts representational adaptation. Meanwhile, prior mechanisms that enable cross-block communication of

summary.core_problem: 现有基于状态的Transformer微调方法多仅采用逐块控制更新，限制了块间信息交换与表征适配能力，而支持跨块通信的现有方案计算开销过高难以落地
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量级混合控制（MoC）微调框架，在保持参数与内存效率的同时实现了高效的Transformer块间信息交互
summary.technical_approach: 将各Transformer块的控制状态视为稀疏混合专家（MoE）过程中的专家，自适应整合局部与全局控制信号，以较低开销实现跨块的控制信息传递与表征适配
summary.experiments: 在多个Transformer基准任务上验证有效性，相比现有基于状态的微调方法取得更优的性能表现，摘要未披露具体模型参数量与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing state-based Transformer fine-tuning methods mostly adopt per-block control updates, limiting inter-block information exchange and representational adaptation, while prior cross-block communication schemes incur prohibitive computational overhead
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing the lightweight Mixture-of-Control (MoC) fine-tuning framework that enables efficient inter-block information interaction for Transformers while maintaining parameter and memory efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats control states of each Transformer block as experts in a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) process, adaptively integrates local and global control signals to achieve cross-block control information transfer and representational adaptation at low cost
summary_en.experiments: Validated effectiveness on multiple Transformer benchmarks, outperforming existing state-based fine-tuning methods. Specific model parameter scales and quantitative improvement margins are not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 参数高效微调的增量改进，仅在块间通信机制上做小创新，对预训练核心流程无直接影响，作为文献备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in parameter-efficient fine-tuning with minor innovation in inter-block communication, no direct impact on core pretraining workflows, keep as literature reference only

paper.title: Radial Suppression Accelerates Algorithmic Generalization: A Geometric Analysis of Delayed Generalization
paper.abstract: Why do neural networks memorize algorithmic training data long before they generalize? We present a geometric case study demonstrating that, on tasks where generalization requires discovering structured low-dimensional circuits, the memorization-generalization delay is driven by radial inflation of hidden representations under cross-entropy optimization. We formalize a radial-angular decomposition of activation-space dynamics and derive three testable propositions: (i) that penalizing radial inf

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究算法任务中的延迟泛化现象：模型很早记住训练集，但要经过很长训练才突然泛化。作者把原因定位到交叉熵训练下隐藏表示的径向膨胀，即表示范数不断变大，使优化优先走向高范数记忆解，而不是形成低维结构化电路。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练方法论文，但对训练动态和泛化机制有参考价值。它给出一个可测量的几何分解：把隐藏表示更新拆成径向分量和角向分量。对语言模型预训练研究来说，启发点在于交叉熵不仅优化分类边界，也会驱动激活范数增长；这种增长可能影响特征形成、有效秩、曲率和后期泛化。该结论不能直接外推到大规模自然语言预训练，但为分析 loss 下降、表示范数、grokking 和结构化能力出现之间的关系提供了一个清晰工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单：在交叉熵之外加入隐藏激活范数惩罚，把目标范数设为 sqrt(d)，其中 d 是隐藏维度。这个目标保持每个特征的平均平方激活随宽度稳定，避免表示无限增大，也避免方差塌缩。在 MLP 中，惩罚作用于所有隐藏层的 pre-activation 输出；在 Pre-LN Transformer 中，惩罚作用于每个子层加到 residual stream 之前的输出，而不是约束累计 residual stream。分析部分将梯度分为径向分量和切向分量，并定义 normalized fractional radial energy。作者提出三点可检验预测：范数惩罚等价于一种数据依赖的各向异性权重正则；它会把径向梯度能量压到各向同性随机基线以下，使更新更多发生在角向；它会引导模型到曲率更低的解。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 modular arithmetic 等算法泛化任务，并覆盖 MLP、Transformer 和 10M 参数 nanoGPT。关键数字比较明确：惩罚模型从初始化开始把归一化径向能量压到约 0.15，显著低于随机各向同性基线 1；在 P=97 的 Fourier 基上，Fourier coherence 达到 R^2>0.9 的时间从 baseline 的 34,200 epoch 提前到 2,460 epoch，主导 Fourier 分量幅度增加约 4 倍；相对强 weight decay，grokking onset 约快 6.3 倍；相对 MAN 约快 6.1 倍；有效秩高于强 weight decay，文中给出 443 对 402。跨架构结果显示最高约 6 倍加速，nanoGPT 上加速较小，作者解释为 affine LayerNorm 已经提供了部分径向抑制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。先看方法部分，确认惩罚加在什么激活上，尤其是 Pre-LN Transformer 中约束子层输出而不是 residual stream 的设计。然后看径向-角向分解和 normalized fractional radial energy 的定义，这是全文最有迁移价值的分析工具。实验部分优先看 Fourier coherence、径向能量曲线、与 weight decay/MAN 的对比表，以及 nanoGPT 结果。若关心大模型训练稳定性，可以重点思考这个惩罚与 LayerNorm、weight decay、logit scale、表示有效秩之间的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies delayed generalization on algorithmic tasks: networks fit the training set early, but test accuracy remains poor for a long time before a sharp transition. The proposed explanation is radial inflation of hidden representations under cross-entropy, which favors high-norm memorizing solutions before structured low-dimensional circuits are assembled.
summary_en.importance: This is not a large-scale LLM pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding training dynamics. Its main contribution is a measurable geometric lens: decompose representation updates into radial and angular components. For pretraining research, the relevant message is that cross-entropy can drive activation norm growth, not just better prediction. That growth can interact with feature formation, effective rank, curvature, and late-emerging generalization. The result should be treated as evidence from controlled algorithmic settings rather than as a direct prescription for web-scale language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The intervention is a centered activation norm penalty with target radius sqrt(d), where d is the hidden width. The target keeps average squared activation per feature stable as width changes, while preventing unbounded norm growth. In MLPs, the penalty is applied to pre-activation hidden outputs. In Pre-LayerNorm Transformers, it is applied to each sublayer output before it is added to the residual stream, so it constrains the increment rather than the accumulated residual state. The analysis decomposes gradients into radial and tangential components and introduces normalized fractional radial energy. The paper then derives three testable predictions: the penalty behaves like a data-dependent anisotropic weight regularizer, it suppresses radial gradient energy below an isotropic random baseline, and it biases training toward flatter solutions.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses algorithmic generalization tasks, including modular arithmetic, across MLPs, Transformers, and a 10M-parameter nanoGPT. Several numbers are notable. The penalty drives normalized radial energy to about 0.15 from initialization, well below the isotropic baseline of 1. On the P=97 Fourier basis, Fourier coherence with R^2>0.9 is reached at epoch 2,460 instead of 34,200 for the baseline, and the dominant Fourier magnitude increases by about 4x. Grokking onset is about 6.3x faster than strong isotropic weight decay and about 6.1x faster than MAN. The effective rank is also higher than under strong weight decay, reported as 443 versus 402. The speedup on nanoGPT is smaller, which the authors attribute to LayerNorm already providing partial radial suppression.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 30 to 40 minutes. Start with the penalty definition and where it is applied, especially the Pre-LN Transformer choice of constraining sublayer outputs rather than the full residual stream. Then read the radial-angular decomposition and the normalized radial energy metric, which are the most reusable parts. In the experiments, focus on the radial energy curves, Fourier coherence timing, comparisons against weight decay and MAN, and the nanoGPT results. For large-model training work, the main follow-up question is how this mechanism interacts with LayerNorm, weight decay, logit scale, effective rank, and loss-spike behavior.

recommendation.zh: 从几何视角拆解grokking训练动态，径向抑制的思路可用于预训练后期泛化加速的消融实验，重点看§3的分解推导和Fig 4的泛化曲线
recommendation.en: Geometric decomposition of grokking dynamics; radial suppression ideas are worth ablation for late-stage pretraining generalization, focus on §3 derivation and Fig 4

paper.title: Transformer Architectures as Complete Bayes Processes: A Formal Proof in the Measure-Theoretic Kernel Framework
paper.abstract: We present a complete formal proof that transformer architectures, when their internal update mechanisms satisfy a Bayes joint-distribution condition, implement exact Bayesian posterior inference. Working within the measure-theoretic kernel framework, we define a hierarchy of abstractions -- from the core Bayesian transformer, through semantic transformers with explicit update kernels, to full transformer blocks with QKV/attention/residual/MLP pipelines, and finally multilayer stacks -- and prov

summary.core_problem: 注意力与贝叶斯推断的关联长期停留在直觉、类比和经验观察层面，缺乏在严格测度论框架下、覆盖真实 Transformer 完整层级结构的形式化证明。
summary.importance: 为理解 Transformer 的归纳偏置和表示性质提供了一条严格的理论路径。对预训练研究的价值主要在机制解释层面：它给出了一组可检验的结构条件，在该条件下前向传播等价于精确后验更新，可用于后续分析训练动态、设计新的架构约束或正则项。工作本身是纯理论结果，不直接给出训练 recipe 或性能提升。
summary.technical_approach: 在可测空间与 Markov 核构成的范畴内工作，构造了四层抽象层级并逐层证明：(1) 核心贝叶斯 Transformer：仅定义先验、似然与后验核，利用有限核的 disintegration 定理建立联合分布恒等式；(2) 语义 Transformer：引入显式内部更新核，提出 Bayes 联合语义条件——更新核与先验、似然复合后能恢复对称联合分布，证明该条件几乎处处推出更新核等于后验核；(3) 完整 Transformer 块：将输入嵌入、QKV 投影、注意力、残差/MLP、读出整条数据流形式化为核的复合，通过 Radon-Nikodym 微分导出块级显式贝叶斯公式并证明归一化；(4) 多层堆叠：将层栈定义为隐藏状态核的有序复合，扩展证明到深度网络。额外证明 softmax 注意力定义合法概率分布，把抽象核框架与标准注意力实现对接。证明不依赖深度、宽度、参数化或训练过程，仅依赖核复合结构和联合语义条件。
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，无实验与消融。所有结论以定理形式给出，依赖标准 Borel 空间、σ-有限测度、有限核等前提。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 40–60 分钟。先读第 1 节明确问题边界和三层贡献；第 2 节重点理解 Bayes 联合语义条件的定义，这是全部证明的支点；第 3 节跳过冗长证明细节，抓住每层抽象的定理陈述与逻辑递进；第 4 节关注 Radon-Nikodym 导数如何把抽象后验落到可计算的块级公式；第 5 节看 softmax 归一化证明如何桥接理论与实际实现；第 6 节的局限与适用范围是判断该结果实用价值的关键。值得深挖的点是：联合语义条件在真实训练过的 Transformer 中是否近似成立，以及能否把该条件转化为训练中的可微正则。

summary_en.core_problem: Connections between attention and Bayesian inference have long remained at the level of intuition, analogy, and empirical observation, lacking a formal proof in a rigorous measure-theoretic framework that covers the full hierarchical structure of real transformers.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a strict theoretical path for understanding the inductive bias and representational properties of transformers. Its value to pretraining research lies primarily in mechanistic interpretation: it gives a set of checkable structural conditions under which forward propagation is equivalent to exact posterior updating, which can guide future analysis of training dynamics and the design of new architectural constraints or regularizers. The result is purely theoretical and does not directly deliver a training recipe or performance gain.
summary_en.technical_approach: Working in the category of measurable spaces with Markov kernels as morphisms, the paper builds a four-layer abstraction hierarchy and proves results level by level: (1) Core Bayesian transformer: defines only prior, likelihood, and posterior kernel, and establishes the joint-distribution identity via the disintegration theorem for finite kernels. (2) Semantic transformer: introduces an explicit internal update kernel and proposes the Bayes joint-semantics condition—composition of the update kernel with prior and likelihood recovers the symmetrized joint law—and proves that this condition implies the update kernel equals the posterior almost everywhere. (3) Full transformer block: formalizes the dataflow of input embedding, QKV projection, attention, residual/MLP, and readout as kernel composition, derives an explicit block-level Bayes formula through Radon-Nikodym differentiation, and proves its normalization. (4) Multilayer stack: defines the layer stack as ordered composition of hidden-state kernels and extends the proof to deep networks. The paper additionally proves that softmax attention defines a valid probability distribution, bridging the abstract kernel framework to standard attention implementations. All proofs depend only on kernel composition structure and the joint-semantics condition; no assumptions on depth, width, parameterization, or training procedure are required.
summary_en.experiments: Purely theoretical work, with no experiments or ablations. All results are stated as theorems under the premises of standard Borel spaces, σ-finite measures, and finite kernels.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading, estimated 40–60 minutes. Start with Section 1 to grasp the problem boundary and the three stated contributions. In Section 2, focus on the definition of the Bayes joint-semantics condition, which is the fulcrum of all subsequent proofs. In Section 3, skip verbose proof details and track the theorem statements and logical progression across abstraction layers. In Section 4, note how the Radon-Nikodym derivative reduces the abstract posterior to a computable block-level formula. In Section 5, see how the softmax normalization proof connects theory to real implementations. Section 6 on scope, assumptions, and limitations is critical for judging the practical relevance of the result. A worthwhile follow-up question is whether the joint-semantics condition holds approximately in real trained transformers, and whether it can be turned into a differentiable regularizer during training.

recommendation.zh: 纯理论证明，对设计贝叶斯启发的注意力或正则化有参考，仅需看§4的块级贝叶斯公式与softmax的概率解释。
recommendation.en: Pure theoretical proof, useful for designing Bayesian-inspired attention or regularization; only read §4's block-level Bayes formula and softmax probabilistic interpretation.

paper.title: How Token Influence Decays with Distance: A Green-Function View of Trained Language Models
paper.abstract: We study how the next-token prediction of an autoregressive Transformer language model changes under small perturbations of earlier input token embeddings. Motivated by operator learning and iterative solvers for differential equations, we investigate how the influence of one token on another decays with distance in a trained model. In multilevel methods for differential equations, such as domain decomposition, multigrid, and multilevel preconditioning, one often exploits a separation between st

summary.core_problem: 需要一种定量方法测量训练好的自回归LLM中早期token扰动对后续预测的影响随距离的衰减规律，弥补注意力权重可视化无法反映真实输入-输出因果影响的缺陷，为层级化架构设计提供实证依据。
summary.importance: 提供了超越注意力可视化的雅可比灵敏度定量分析工具；发现的幂律衰减特性（而非RNN的指数衰减）解释了Transformer长程建模能力的来源；验证的长程响应模式为类多重网格的层级LLM架构、长上下文优化方案提供了实证基础。
summary.technical_approach: 借鉴微分方程数值求解中格林函数（衡量局部输入扰动对另一位置解的影响）的思想，将训练好的LLM前向传播视为非线性算子，通过自动微分计算距离分辨的雅可比灵敏度：对每个目标位置的下一个token logit（取真实标签或模型预测对应的分量），计算其对不同因果距离的早期输入token嵌入无穷小扰动的导数，得到按距离分组的梯度剖面；对比幂律与指数衰减的拟合效果，通过token打乱、随机权重等控制实验区分训练习得特性与架构固有偏置。
summary.experiments: 在多个语料库和模型上，训练好的Transformer长程雅可比灵敏度呈现稳定的幂律型衰减，与经典RNN的指数衰减形成对比；该衰减效应在token打乱后仍然存在，但随机权重模型中完全消失，证明长程响应是训练习得的特性；中位数对角归一化剖面在测量距离范围内可被幂律函数良好拟合。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章引言中微分方程层级求解器与LLM的类比动机、第2章格林函数到Transformer雅可比的映射定义、实验部分的衰减模式拟合对比图；预计阅读时间25-30分钟，无需深究微分方程理论细节，重点把握分析方法与实证结论。

summary_en.core_problem: A quantitative method is needed to measure the distance-dependent decay of early token perturbations' impact on subsequent predictions in trained autoregressive LLMs, addressing the limitation that attention weight visualizations cannot reflect true input-output causal effects, and providing empirical evidence for hierarchical architecture design.
summary_en.importance: Provides a Jacobian-sensitivity-based quantitative token interaction analysis tool beyond attention visualization; the discovered power-law decay (instead of exponential decay in RNNs) explains the source of Transformer's long-range modeling capability; the verified long-range response modes lay empirical foundation for multigrid-like hierarchical LLM architectures and long-context optimization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Green's functions in differential equation solving (which measure the impact of a localized input perturbation at one point on the solution at another), this work treats the forward pass of a trained LLM as a nonlinear operator and computes distance-resolved Jacobian sensitivities via automatic differentiation: for each target position, it selects the logit component corresponding to either the ground-truth next token or the model's prediction, and calculates its derivative with respect to infinitesimal perturbations of input token embeddings at different causal distances to obtain distance-binned gradient profiles. It compares fitting performance of power-law and exponential decay models, and uses control experiments (shuffled tokens, random weights) to distinguish learned properties from architectural inductive biases.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple corpora and model variants, trained Transformers exhibit stable power-law decay of long-range Jacobian sensitivity, in contrast to the exponential decay observed in classical RNNs; the decay effect persists after token shuffling but disappears entirely in models with random weights, confirming long-range responses are learned rather than architectural biases; the median diagonal-normalized profile is well fitted by a power-law function over the measured distance range.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 (motivation linking hierarchical differential equation solvers to LLMs), Section 2 (mapping from Green's functions to Transformer Jacobians and formal sensitivity definitions), and experimental figures comparing decay pattern fitting; estimated reading time 25-30 minutes, no need to dive into differential equation theoretical details, prioritize understanding the analysis methodology and empirical conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验定义和 decay 拟合图；若 power-law 结论稳，会削弱很多“长距影响可指数截断”的工程直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the measurement setup and decay fits; if the power-law result holds, it weakens the engineering instinct that long-range influence can be exponentially truncated.

paper.title: The Context-Ready Transformer
paper.abstract: We introduce the context-ready transformer, a new recurrent neural network architecture built from a D-layer transformer block that pre-contextualizes each token before it enters the block. During left-to-right generation, a correction network combines the previous position's block output -- a cached summary of past context -- with the current token embedding, so the tokenenters the block already contextualized rather than as a raw embedding. At sequential inference, the correction chain makes t

summary.core_problem: 标准自回归 Transformer 在生成每个新 token 时，都从一个上下文无关的 embedding 重新开始做上下文化；这项工作尝试让新 token 在进入 Transformer block 前，就带有来自历史的上下文修正。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构方向工作，和预训练效率、推理深度、RNN/Transformer 混合形式有关。它的价值在于提出一种“训练时并行、推理时递归”的结构：训练阶段用少量固定步数近似递归固定点，推理阶段依赖上一个位置的 block output 做即时修正。若结果能在更大规模上成立，它提供了一条减少 sequential inference 有效深度的路径，也给“宽而浅”的语言模型设计增加了一个具体机制。
